{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|collar}}
[[File:SlaveCollar-NEGWT.png|thumb|200px|A typical slaving collar.]]
The '''slaving collar''' was designed to keep prisoners and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in line. The collar consisted of a neck brace that was often linked to chains or cables. It sometimes featured shock panels to shock an unruly captive, in which case it was referred to as a '''shock collar'''. Some types of slave collars would also be designed to explode if one attempted to improperly remove it, or be detonated by transmiter if the slave attempted to escape.

==Description==
Slaving collars generally consisted of adjustable braces that were affixed around the neck, [[Limb/Legends|arms]], or legs. Multiple collars could be linked together using chains or conductive cables. Most slaving collars were constructed of reinforced [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], and some models incorporated [[shock panel]]s into them which were capable of delivering electrical shock charges to the wearer. The collars could be remotely activated by a [[shock controller]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Because slaving collars were illegal in most [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], they could not be purchased legally. They were either sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] or built in back-alley workshops.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[File:MandoShockCollar-TA.png|thumb|left|180px|A New Mandalorian shock collar]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] used shock collars to control prisoners and slaves prone to disobedience, including [[Vette]]. Certain [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prisons such as [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] also make use of shock collars on their prisoners.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Mandalorian secret service/Legends|Secret Service]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction used this collar to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].

The [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] used them to keep slaves under control.<ref name="SOTR">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], captured [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were usually forced into chain groups with a slaving collar around their necks by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers. Usually the lowest ranking member of the slaver patrol had to place these collars around the Wookiees' necks — a very dangerous job.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] endured the humiliation of the slave collar while being held captive by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], Leia's daughter, was also forced to wear one for a short time during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
